root_velocity_method: negative median signed forward velocity of pelvis-relative fixed heel/toe centroids over adjacent pairs with both heights <=40mm; 21-frame 30fps cycle; root velocity held constant for reconstructed trajectory
interpretation_limits: Forward travel is inferred from in-place contact-phase motion, not authored root translation.
The inferred constant speed is fit to the same contact windows being evaluated; reconstructed residuals are descriptive, not independent proof of natural planted contact.
Only fixed landmarks from the existing gait report are used; no lowest-vertex identity changes occur.
